title: Issue with Basal Profile Update – Equil Firmware 5.4
body:
Dear Support Team,
I am experiencing an issue when trying to update the basal profile on the Equil pump using AAPS.
When attempting to upload a profile containing 23 basal segments, the update fails. However, the exact same profile uploads without any issues on the Dana RS pump. I then simplified the profile to only four basal segments, which successfully uploaded to the Equil pump.
That said, applying a temporary basal change of 110% to this simplified profile also failed, consistently resulting in an error message.
For further investigation, I have sent the relevant logs to your email on September 28, 2025, around 11:45 AM.
System details:
•	AAPS version: 3.3.2.1
•	Android version: 14
•	Phone: Samsung SM-A528B
•	Equil firmware version: 5.4
I would appreciate your help in resolving this issue. Please let me know if you need any additional information.
Best regards

comments.body: Hi, I don't have Equil 5.4 at the moment

it was not related only to 5.4
resolved by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/3139f8a81ea99051005b34f7533af990288a2e45
